ELI5: Why do countries have flags?
I have a pillow fort, and you have a pillow fort. How do we know which is which? Flags! Also, if we have a nerf gun war with our armies, how do we tell which is which? Flags! Also, nationalism.
so they don't shoot each other during war
So they don't shoot themselves. The whole idea of a war is that countries shoot each other.

To assist in identifying a particular country or group their of in a setting with multiple countries. For example at a sporting event, each countries flags act as a sign post advertising where they are. It is used also for identifying ships as belonging to a particular country as well.
so they have something to stick in the ground when they take land

I think it stems from ships- either commerce or war. Likely more war than anything else. Before any sort of modern electronics, the only way to identify the country of origin of a sailing vessel was visually. If you were in a sea battle, it was impossible to know if you're firing on a friendly or a hostile without some kind of visual marker.

Probably goes back further than that, even, when knights wore full armor and then realized that everyone looked the same and they needed to identify people on their side or enemies.
